key_idea: Any palindrome of length >= 2 contains a palindrome of length 2 or 3 at its center, so only check s[i]==s[i+1] or s[i]==s[i+2].
sketch: Read the whole line, keep only letters and lowercase them. If any adjacent pair is equal or any pair at distance two is equal, print Palindrome, otherwise Anti-palindrome. O(length). Pitfalls: read with getline because of spaces, ignore all non-alphabetic characters before testing adjacency, and compare case-insensitively.
